# SpikingNeuralNetwork

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neural network model where neurons communicate via discrete spikes in time, encoding information in spike timing and rates. Core computational primitive for iNEST, enabling energy-efficient, event-driven processing directly in network nodes.
